$comment: Generated by orchestrator/backend/scripts/generate_agent_schemas.py from app.api.assessment.AccessRecordRequest plus agent-side overlays where the CLI contract is intentionally stricter than the backend model.

access_key.title: Access Key
access_key.description: Stable dedupe key for this access entry. Use kebab-case: '<principal>-<target>-<level>' (e.g. 'admin-db01-root').

credential_id.title: Credential Id
credential_id.description: ID of the credential record used to gain this access. Omit if no credential record exists yet.

service_id.title: Service Id
service_id.description: ID of the service this access applies to. Omit if access is not tied to a specific service.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: Account or identity that holds this access (e.g. 'root', 'admin@corp.example', 'arn:aws:iam::123:role/Prod').

access_level.title: Access Level
access_level.description: Privilege tier obtained (e.g. 'read', 'admin', 'root', 'domain-admin', 'rce'). Use the most specific label that fits.

target_ref.title: Target Ref
target_ref.description: What the principal can access: host, URL, database, cloud resource ARN, or scope (e.g. 'db01.internal', 'https://app.example/', 'arn:aws:s3:::prod-bucket').

status.title: Status
status.description: Validity state of this access. Use 'active' when confirmed working, 'revoked' when credentials are burned or blocked.

evidence_ref.title: Evidence Ref
evidence_ref.description: Path or ID of the artifact proving access (e.g. 'scans/ssh-session.log'). Leave empty if evidence is in notes.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: How access was obtained, lateral-movement path, or operational caveats.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Agent or tool that recorded this access (e.g. {"agent_name": "post-exploitation"}).

title: Assessment Access Record
